messages:
maria: Quick thought — we need a clearer link between routing decisions and per-request logs in Console. Hard to debug when a request is routed to variant-b and then falls back; trace shows only final model.
jasper: Saw this in a support ticket yesterday. +1 for better visibility. we end up guessing which policy fired.
kai: UX sketch idea: add a 'Routing decision' panel in the request trace that shows ordered rules, matched predicates, scores, and fallback reasons. compact by default.
